description: The WHO Catalogue of Prequalified Immunization Devices lists the characteristics of every immunisation-related product and device currently prequalified by WHO for procurement by United Nations agencies; it replaced the WHO/UNICEF Product Information Sheets last issued in 2000 and supports the supply chain and cold chain work of the WHO Essential Programme on Immunization. Coverage: global procurement; product categories E001 cold rooms and freezer rooms, E002 refrigerated vehicles, E003 refrigerators and freezers, E004 cold boxes and vaccine carriers, E005 coolant packs, E006 temperature monitoring devices, E007 cold chain accessories, E008 and E013 injection devices, and E010 waste management equipment. Each product has a permanent IMD-PQS code (for example E001-001) with status, date of acceptance, manufacturer and technical data sheet fields. Format and access: a full PDF catalogue (about 30 MB) and a JSON file of the whole database (about 1.8 MB), both last modified on 22 September 2026, plus online search and per-category technical guidance; free. Licence: the catalogue's conditions of use disclaim completeness and liability; no reuse licence was read. Caveats: the catalogue is updated continuously and date-stamped per edition, holds only products that passed WHO verification, and WHO may suspend or withdraw products; the Effective Vaccine Management assessment data named on the EPI supply chain page were not found (that page link returned 404). Simulation uses: equipment specifications for modelling vaccine cold chains, health supply logistics and emergency response. Related records: the catalogue has no close neighbour; the DHIS2 platform (platform-dhis2-health-information-system) is another health system data resource in the catalogue.
